sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The request budget shared with majkinetor's scripts (mbu:mb-gate) no longer lets two tabs take the same request slot. After booking a slot this script now keeps the shared lock 30 ms longer, as majkinetor's scripts do since String Theory 2026.11.23, so the booking reaches every other MusicBrainz tab before the next one reads the schedule. The request itself is not delayed, and this script's own pace (one request per 1.1 s, never faster than one a second in the shared schedule) stays as it was, although majkinetor's scripts now go faster.
